{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZjebag", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhDKNSE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 49, "title": "Initialize HLE dual-CPU FRT communication and slave raster routing", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At main `e92724da1239c8f1c1cac739cf8ef929747b047a`, HLE startup establishes stacks and vector tables but omits the documented FRT communication configuration. `OnChip::default` leaves TIER=1, IPRB=0 and VCRC=0; neither `hle::install` nor `hle/boot.s` initializes the capture enable, priority or vector. Consequently, registering handlers and issuing the standard interprocessor capture strobes cannot produce the expected interrupts without additional guest hardware initialization.

The shared trampoline also writes ICR.VECMD=1 before distinguishing processors. The current slave raster route delivers vectors only with VECMD=0, so HLE guests cannot use that route without repairing ICR themselves. Existing external-BIOS diagnostics explicitly configure their hardware and therefore do not establish this HLE startup behavior.

This is a consequential bootstrap dependency for multiprocessor software, rather than another refinement of the already implemented FRT or raster interrupt mechanisms.

## Expected outcome

Original guest-executed HLE initialization supplies usable FRT capture communication on both processors and the documented slave raster vectors. Applications register handlers, choose their SR mask and perform ordinary MMIO communication without reconstructing the boot environment.

The [System Program manual guide, interrupt initialization table](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/prgg/sysg/prog/hon/p01_10.htm) specifies capture vector 0x64, initial priority 15 and disabled priorities for other internal interrupt groups. Derive register encodings, access widths and acknowledgement behavior from the [SH7604 Hardware Manual](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/sh7604.pdf), §§5.3–5.4 and 11.2–11.5.

Use [STN-28 attachment, Dual CPU Usage Ver.1.1](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/info/hon/stn28_1.htm), §§2.3, 4.3–4.5 and 5, for slave raster interrupts, entry registration, capture initialization, vector-table retention and restart behavior. Reconcile the older [ST-202-R1](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-202-R1-120994.pdf), printed p.3: its entry index 0x164 and capture level 1 conflict with the later attachment's entry index 0x94 and level 15. Entry registration and interrupt-handler registration are distinct operations.

Keep the implementation focused:

- Initialize CPU-local FRT communication through original SH-2 instructions in the HLE bootstrap. Preserve architectural hardware-reset defaults and the separate external-BIOS path.
- Select master external-vector delivery and supported slave autovector delivery separately. Document slave autovector selection as the HLE configuration used to provide the specified vectors; do not invent an unimplemented board-vector acquisition cycle or claim an exact Sega ROM register dump.
- Preserve existing default/custom stack metadata, handler registration and shared-memory coherence rules. Slave restart must not reinstall or overwrite retained application vector tables.
- Limit changes to this startup/restart contract, its independent fixtures and affected documentation. Full BIOS initialization, other HLE services, physical synchronizer timing and general pipeline work remain outside this increment.

Primary specifications and applicable corrections govern the contract. If implementation discovers an erroneous AI-authored assumption here, update this Issue with exact references and rationale while preserving meaningful independent acceptance; no human-confirmation gate is needed.

## Context and reproduction

Relevant implementation:

- `src/hle/boot.s:5–27` writes the same ICR mode on both CPUs and enters application code without FRT setup.
- `src/hle.rs:7–79` installs original code, vectors and service data without that CPU-local configuration.
- `src/onchip.rs:78–103` retains hardware-reset peripheral values; `interrupt` at lines 493–540 requires enabled capture and nonzero priority.
- `src/bus.rs:421–446` and `src/onchip.rs:699–711` distinguish master vector delivery from the supported slave autovector route.
- `tests/hle_system.rs` validates services but does not demonstrate communication using boot-provided FRT defaults. `tests/dual_sh2.rs` and `tests/slave_raster.rs` use external synthetic BIOS fixtures.

Reproduce with an original HLE disc that registers both capture handlers, starts the slave, unmasks capture interrupts and exchanges word strobes without programming TIER/IPRB/VCRC. A separate stage registers slave raster handlers and unmasks them without writing ICR. The inherited implementation cannot complete those stages correctly.

There are no open task Issues in the supplied snapshot. #47's validation explicitly leaves HLE interrupt initialization outstanding. Current main build CI is in progress, with no final conclusion; it is neither a failure nor evidence of completion.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document a primary-derived startup contract covering both processors' capture enables, vector fields, priorities, external-vector selection and initialization order. Explicitly reconcile the older manual discrepancies above. Verify guest-visible configuration at application entry against independently authored literals, including capture priority 15/vector 0x64 and disabled unrelated internal priorities.
- [ ] Add a reproducible original permissively licensed HLE diagnostic disc. Both CPUs must execute handlers and ordinary computations using boot-provided capture configuration, with no application writes to TIER/IPRB/VCRC. Demonstrate bidirectional communication, SLEEP wake, correct exception frames, guest acknowledgement, RTE and subsequent communication. Include changed arithmetic operands and an omitted-strobe control with independently predicted records.
- [ ] In the same diagnostic, demonstrate HLE slave HBlank/VBlank handling without application ICR writes. Check the specified vectors, SR masking, level re-entry and independence from master SCU masks/status. Preserve existing #47 timing and reset assertions.
- [ ] Add focused native boundary checks for capture assertion, masked pending capture, unmasking and acknowledgement. Confirm that bootstrap initialization creates no phantom capture request and does not alter architectural reset defaults. Use literal expectations rather than production helpers to generate expected results.
- [ ] Exercise SSHOFF/SSHON with registered handlers and changed entry operands, proving that CPU-local initialization reruns while vector-table bytes and appropriate shared state survive. Exercise slave restart after both clock selections, plus cold boot and SYSRES. Preserve existing default/custom stack, backup, power-clear and reset-domain assertions.
- [ ] Execute identical diagnostic bytes through native Machine and rebuilt production browser Wasm under `/saturn-rust/`. Compare authored records across repeated boots; native execution must agree across chunks 1/3/17/10000 and passive debugger inspection. Hosts may load fixtures and inspect results but must not supply guest calculations or interrupt outcomes.
- [ ] Demonstrate that the independent FRT and HLE raster assertions fail against the inherited bootstrap behavior and pass with the completed implementation. Register fixture reproduction in existing CI and retain all existing tests and demos. Explain any necessary fixture adjustment with primary evidence while preserving its substantive assertions.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native all-target Clippy and wasm32 Clippy with `-D warnings`, all workflow-registered fixture/media reproduction checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh` and the complete `npm run test:browser`. Preserve Star Collector, Prism Courier, Hardware Lab, Canvas/audio, input, backup and local-file privacy coverage.
- [ ] Update the conformance matrix, HLE documentation and validation record with exact implementation/test/specification links, actual results, negative controls and remaining deviations. Report this as a partial #17 increment without closing keywords or hardware-completion claims.

## Optional validation

None required. Personal firmware, commercial discs, physical hardware, human approval and live Pages inspection are unnecessary.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

The remaining #17 CPU/peripheral, bus/cache/reset/timing, SCU/DSP, video/audio, CD/media/HLE, SMPC and comprehensive integration requirements remain mandatory. Genuine BIOS and commercial-game compatibility remain independently unverified. Administrative tracker closure and green CI do not establish hardware completion.
